title: COMMANDED AT SINAI, IN THE DESERT

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'which the LORD gave Moses at Mount Sinai in the Desert of Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the LORD.'" - Lev 7:38 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The section closes by naming the place: Mount Sinai, in the desert.

Not in the Promised Land. Not in a settled city with a temple. In a wilderness, among people living in tents, with an uncertain future and no permanent address.

God gave His people a complete system of worship before He gave them a country.

That order says something. Israel's identity was not built on land, security, or success. It was built on knowing how to come to God. Everything else could change — and it did, repeatedly, through exile and return and occupation. This did not.

If you are in a wilderness season yourself — unsettled, waiting, unsure what comes next — this closing verse is for you. God's most detailed instructions about knowing Him were given to people who had nothing settled at all.

Jesus told the woman at the well that the location of worship was about to stop mattering. A time is coming and has now come when the true worshippers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth (Jn 4:23).

You do not have to arrive somewhere before you can worship. Sinai was a desert, and God met them there.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I waiting for my circumstances to settle before I take my walk with God seriously?
2. What has God taught me in a wilderness season that I could not have learned elsewhere?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You met Your people in the desert and taught them how to come to You there. Meet me where I am today, unsettled as it may be. Amen.
